(Nasdaq: TRAX), a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing antibody therapeutics that modulate immune pathways implicated in autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, today announced positive top-line results from Cohort 1 (gluten challenge) of ANB033’s Phase 1b trial in celiac disease (CeD).

Cohort 2 of ANB033’s Phase 1b trial in CeD, which is assessing mucosal healing in patients with a broad range of histologic (Vh:Cd ratio ≤ 2.5) and symptom severity through 12 weeks, is on track to complete enrollment imminently, with top-line data anticipated in Q1 2027.
A Phase 1b cohort in eosinophilic esophagitis (EoE) is enrolling 50 patients with top-line data anticipated in Q3 2027.
